project.title: The Monument That Lives in My Memory
project.logline: A personal journey back to Harar reveals that even when a beloved childhood landmark is gone, its memories remain part of who we are.
project.central_message: Heritage is not only about physical monuments; it is also about the memories and emotions people attach to places.

notes: First-person personal story only; no political commentary or blame.
No fabricated historical dates or unverified architectural claims about the Ras Makonnen Monument.
All AI-generated reconstructions must be explicitly distinguished from authentic historical photographs.

audio_mix.ducking_notes: Duck instrumental score smoothly beneath Amharic narration using FFmpeg sidechain compression during assembly (Step 10+).

end_card.disclosure_text: Created with AI tools (Gemini, FLUX, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step) as an artistic personal-memory reconstruction. Not archival footage or historical photography.

voice_settings.speaking_style: calm, warm, reflective, unhurried first-person storytelling
